titulo: Your AI chatbot isn't learning from you 🧊
descripcion: While you chat, the model's weights never change. It 'remembers' because the whole conversation is sent again every time. Full breakdown in the linked video.

escenas.texto: Your AI chatbot isn't learning anything from talking to you.
Its numbers are frozen. Not a single one changes while you chat.
